final: SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_units_invoiced, avg_cost_difference_ratio, color_rank FROM (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_units_invoiced, avg_cost_difference_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_units_invoiced DESC) AS color_rank FROM (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_units_invoiced, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0.0)) AS avg_cost_difference_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili INNER JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id INNER JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color)) WHERE color_rank <= 3
